notes.title: Soundtrack Release and Colorblind Accessibility
notes.notes:
I just submitted an update that fixes a number of minor bugs. It also improves the game's colorblind accessibility substantially. Symbols now appear above the Styx whirlwinds and most of the elemental switch orbs, which I hope will eliminate some confusion, perhaps even among players without colorblindness.

The other major piece of news is that the soundtrack for the game has been released. You can get it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688740/The_Spectral_Web_Hitodama_Soundtrack/]here![/url]

Between this and other recent updates, I think all the major bugs have been caught and addressed. (Knock on wood.) There are some minor ones left that shouldn't impact the play experience much. As such, there probably won't be another update for awhile.

Thanks so much for playing!

-Aevin
